messages:
Anjali (support): Hey team — escalated from Tom. Customer sees a lot of 401s and high latency after our latest failover policy change. He says requests meant for us-west are hitting eu-central and failing auth.

Tom (customer): seeing ~300ms -> 900ms p50, and many 401s. API key should be bound to us-west.

Anjali (support): I repro'd quickly: call with X-Region: us-west but response shows X-Routed-Region: eu-central in logs. Posting config they applied below.

Anjali (support): ```json
{
  "failover_policy": {
    "regions": ["us-west-2", "eu-central-1"],
    "weights": {"us-west-2": 70, "eu-central-1": 30},
    "sticky": false
  }
}
```

Kevin (eng-runtime): Thanks. Quick q: did they use priority array or rely on order? Runtime historically treated the first item as highest priority; some recent change switched to sorting by weight when weight present.

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-12T14:22:01 - release/runtime-routing v2.13.0 applied to prod region routing.

Kevin (eng-runtime): aha — v2.13 reads weights and switches selection heuristics; combined with sticky:false the session can jump and hit eu when load balancing picks weight. If their API key is region-scoped to us-west they get 401 when routed to eu.

Maya (oncall): Can we repro locally? Anjali, do you have a curl snippet?

Anjali (support): Yup: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer KEY-TO-US-WEST" -H "X-Region: us-west-2" https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
# Response headers show: X-Routed-Region: eu-central-1
# HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
```

Kevin (eng-runtime): Logged the routing decision for that request id: r_0f3a2b. Decision: weight-based selection favored eu-central because we had a transient us-west spike. But priority array was expected to override weights for region-bound keys. Looks like v2.13 bug: priority override not applied when weights present and sticky=false.

Anjali (support): Customer impact: auth failures + higher latency. They've paused production traffic. Marking P1.

opsbot: Created incident INC-7893: "failover: weight-priority interaction causes cross-region routing -> 401s" assigned to eng-runtime.

Kevin (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigation: set failover_policy.sticky = true or remove eu-central weight / set weight to 0 for that customer. We can also pin customer to us-west via a quota/route override. I'll push a hotfix to make priority array take precedence immediately.

Anjali (support): I pushed a customer-scoped override to pin their key to us-west as immediate mitigation. Notified Tom.

Tom (customer): Thanks, that's much better now. Latency back to ~250ms and no 401s.

Kevin (eng-runtime): Action items: 1) roll v2.13 hotfix to respect priority array even when weights exist (ETA 2h) 2) add telemetry to surface when weight selection routes away from explicit priority 3) doc note on sticky default behavior. I'll own 1 and 2.

Maya (oncall): I'll keep monitoring INC-7893 and escalate if we see more pinned keys failing.

Anjali (support): Closing the customer loop. Great work :thumbsup:
